run_config.execution_vehicle: production Service replay: rag_judge_service.judge_trace(session=None, trace=synthetic RagTrace, item=synthetic item, prompt_version='v1.2.2'); driver only aggregates JudgeOutcome; no reimplementation of F scoring

synthetic_trace.note: context_source=agent_chat is required by _skip_reason for F; no RAG adapter call; no RagEvaluationRun

fixture.note: fixed v1.1.5 gate answer/contexts/gold; no mutation of fixture; fixture target field is historical, v1.0.2 target is authoritative

run_config.llm_endpoint: existing DashScope-compatible endpoint used by prior qwen-max gates; no key in repo
run_config.credential_scope: existing runtime LLM credential (BYOK or server-key fallback); preflight must verify; no key in repo
run_config.env_scope: process-local for this Judge-only replay only; do not write to repo/.env; restore after replay
run_config.top_k_note: not applicable: contexts are fixed fixture inputs; no retrieval/adapter call

forbidden: mixed sentence kept as one factual claim
acceptance.target_miss_policy: report F vs [0.4, 0.5]; do not change target

acceptance.semantic_rule: claim about 质量问题不受 7 天限制 must be insufficient_evidence unless a quote directly states that exemption
forbidden_support: 运费由责任方承担 quote supporting 7-day exemption
7 天内可换货 quote supporting 7-day exemption
acceptance.target_miss_policy: semantic_pass_target_miss -> stop and await human target review; do not change target
acceptance.f_one_policy: if F remains 1.0 and freight/exchange quote still supports 7-day exemption -> diagnostic fail; no in-round rerun

acceptance.quote_rule: single contiguous verbatim span; no cross-fragment concatenation

budget.count_rule: count every Judge model call, including repair and retry; stop when > 14 calls or > CNY 0.30
budget.no_repeat_policy: no repeat runs; single-case results are diagnostic only and are not counted toward the 10-case sample

acceptance_assertions: Q23 F / F_strict 均为 evaluated，不得 invalid
Q23 absence claim 为 non_factual + absence + support_status=null + evidence_refs=[]
Q23 不得出现 factual_claim + absence、absence 标 supported 或 absence 附 evidence
Q23 混合句拆分事实部分与 absence 部分
Q23 F 与 [0.4, 0.5] 比较，不修改目标
Q23 C / R 真实 evaluated，不得为占位 0.0
Q21 “质量问题不受 7 天限制” claim 为 insufficient_evidence，或有直接写明该豁免的 quote
Q21 不得用运费或 7 天换货 quote 支持 7 天限制豁免
Q21 排除项反推只能 insufficient_evidence，不得 supported
Q21 F evaluated，不得 invalid
Q21 F 目标 [0.6, 0.7] 单独报告；semantic_pass_target_miss 停止待人工复核
Q21 F=1.0 且仍用运费/换货 quote 支持 → 诊断失败，本轮不得重跑
Q11 F evaluated
Q11 quote 为单段逐字连续原文，不得跨片段拼接
Q11 无 quote_not_found 或其它 contract violation
每 case/metric 原始输出包含实际使用的 repair 轮
报告 Q21/Q23 claim 级明细
Prompt/MANIFEST/fixture/target/agent repair SHA 不漂移
不创建 RagEvaluationRun、不写 DB、不调 WeKnora、不激活 v1.2.2

Q23/Q21/Q11 任一缺完整 F/C/R 结果
